original_test_intent: Verify that the powered-on SUT and BMC remain continuously stable and reachable during a defined thirty-minute OS-idle interval without hang, blue screen or new platform errors.
original_method: Preserve baseline, record original hibernate/power policy, apply only the approved reversible idle policy, collect continuous reachability and periodic BMC/OS/sensor/event samples for thirty minutes, then restore policy and compare health.
manual_activity: The owner defines idle and approves any hibernate/power-policy change; an operator confirms target state and remains available for console recovery.
required_inputs: Definition of idle and excluded activity
safety_requirements: Stop on hang, wake/reboot, reachability loss or sensor alarm
agent_execution_scope: Run timestamped reachability/event monitoring for full interval
Restore policy and report evidence without verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: BMC mc info is a useful identity/reachability sample, but one end sample and plaintext credential arguments cannot establish continuous OS/BMC stability.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected periodic BMC identity/reachability plus OS/event/sensor sampling over the entire thirty-minute approved idle interval.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Booted OS, disable-hibernate intent, thirty-minute idle, no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen criteria, script and 15/30-minute fields remain.

modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines the idle state, monitoring completeness and reversible policy restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An end-only mc-info response cannot detect transient outages, wake events or OS failure.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power-policy changes may alter sleep/wake behavior and mask the intended idle state.

project_override_considerations: If hibernate is already disabled, record rather than rewrite it. Any background health collector must be low-impact enough not to invalidate the project definition of idle.
expected_evidence: Approval, identities and original/temporary power-policy values
Complete timestamped reachability and periodic health samples
Any loss, wake, reboot, error or policy drift window
Post-idle health and restored policy audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source consistently defines a thirty-minute idle stability case; missing sampling and policy detail are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Idle definition, policy, sampling and recovery are finite inputs, allowing conditional execution.

review_improvement: Extends DeepSeek's endpoint check into full-window SUT/BMC stability monitoring with an auditable reversible power-policy change.
independent_technical_reasoning: Idle stability is a time property: success requires absence of transient reachability, OS and event failures throughout the window. Monitoring must be frequent enough to capture gaps while not generating workload that defeats the idle condition.
